warnings: Layer 1 and Layer 4 made no repository mutation: no source edit, no commit, no push, no PR, no registry or schema change, no l9-pr-repair mutation enablement.
All nine repositories are checked out at their origin/main tips with clean git trees. Eight sit on branch claude/layer-4-activation-wb6bgf whose SHA is identical to origin/main.

Layer 1 environment caveat: the harness ran ensurepip into four repo-local gitignored .venv directories to repair pip-less venvs left by the session-deps hook. Removal was attempted and denied by the operator permission gate, so l9-ci-debt-intelligence, l9-ci-debt-lsp, l9-ci-debt-resolver and l9-ci-core still carry a harness-added pip tree under .venv. This is why l9-ci-debt-intelligence reports one failing test.
final_statement: DO NOT DEPLOY. All three input layers ran. Layer 1 is 'fail': 9/9 install and 8/9 pass their own health command, with 1 repository defect(s): l9-ci-sdk. Layer 2 is 'partial': 5/7 seams pass, 2 partial, 0 fail. Layer 3 is 'partial': 4/6 corridors pass, 2 skipped behind a non-passing seam, 0 fail. Nothing failed outright and nothing was forced with a hand-authored artifact, but a partial seam and a skipped corridor are not passes: editor_advisory, standalone_repair_safety remain unproven, 5 of 15 fail-closed negative tests never ran, and l9-ci-sdk's own gate fails on an unsuppressed workflow-security finding. Cross-layer SHA alignment is a documented non-goal (see layer-4/receipts/sha-consistency.json); it does not affect this verdict either way.
